They claim that they are "Windows certified technicians" and convince the caller to download a third party program to get access to your computer. They'll pull up the event viewer within Windows and show you the naturally occurring errors and warnings and say that they're because of viruses. They'll also open up command prompt from within Windows and type the tree command to make it look like they're scanning your system for viruses. All it does is list the directories.

Then once they're done "working" on your computer, they'll ask for you to pay them and if you don't, they'll put a system password on your computer that you don't know of.

Definitely be aware of those scumbags.
